$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoTitle: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper - Every Greenhouse Job Board
seoDescription: Search every company on Greenhouse at once: job titles, salary ranges, locations, remote work and posting dates. Live, no login or Greenhouse API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: TODO_DEPLOYED: measure the empty form {"maxJobs":100} at 1024 and 2048 MB on the deployed build (seconds, usageTotalUsd, run ids) and keep the cheaper size that finishes well inside 300 s. 2 GB until then, for the description search: on the laptop (2026-11-03, macOS peak footprint) a kubernetes description search peaked at 1.53 GB at the 2 GB setting (the 100 biggest boards 10 at once) and 0.88 GB at 1 GB (3 at once); a plain pass peaked at 394 MB (f-empty2) and every job, maxJobs 0, at 669 MB (f-final-all). minMemoryMbytes is 1024 for that.

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-02. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: fantastic-jobs/greenhouse-jobs-api, the most used actor made for Greenhouse (156 u30): $0.002 a job on FREE and BRONZE, $0.0012 on SILVER and above, no start fee, one row with the description from its own database. job is 10% under it and job-details 5% under it on FREE and BRONZE. Others: bovi $0.0015 + $0.00005 start (company slugs or preset lists), yugenox $0.002 (live keyword search, Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby), bytepulselabs $0.002 (board links), automation-lab $0.002 + $0.01 start, jobo.world $0.004 (database). No start fee: a search reads every board, about $0.011-0.013 of compute at 2 GB (estimate from the siblings' $0.0001 a second, TODO_DEPLOYED), 6-7% of the $0.18 that 100 rows earn, under the 10% rule. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, locations, work type, job type, pay, posting date, deadline, job link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, the department, the company's reference number and pay as numbers with its currency.
